seo.title: OneFam — For souls who belong to more than one place
seo.description: Clothing and a community for everyone whose answer to «Where are you from?» has a comma in it. Not for everyone – and that is exactly the point.

hero.claim: For souls who belong to more than one place
hero.subline: Clothing and a community for everyone whose answer has a comma in it.

what_is_onefam.title: What is OneFam?
what_is_onefam.intro: OneFam is not your usual clothing brand. OneFam is a space for people who take each other seriously – including the dreams you don't tell anyone else.

cards.title: Values, not facade.
cards.text: Clothing expresses where you stand. It isn't the point.

cards.title: Moments, not small talk.
cards.text: We don't talk about the weather. We ask what you're working on – and we mean it.

steps.text: OneFam is a brand with a shop – we design and sell clothing for people who belong to more than one place.
A fixed share of our profit stays set aside – for what we have planned with the community. That is a promise we make to ourselves, not something you get in return for buying.
Our goal: one day we travel together. We are building this carefully and properly – and we'll say so when the time comes.
Anyone who wants to be there joins the waiting list. No purchase, no conditions, unsubscribe any time.
When the time comes, buyers should help decide the destination. Nothing to win, no advantage over anyone.

travel_pool.label: Our vision
travel_pool.title: One day we travel together.
travel_pool.description: Part of our profit stays reserved for the Fam – for the day we meet somewhere other than online. This is not an offer yet. It is the direction we are heading in.
points: We start at zero – and take you along from the very beginning.
None of it is sold, promised or raffled off.
When the time comes, you'll hear it first.

product_bridge.label: The pieces
product_bridge.title: A quiet sign of recognition.
product_bridge.intro: No catalogue item, no logo to show off. A sign the right people notice – and everyone else walks past. Exactly as it should be.

lines.name: The logo line
lines.text: The quiet basic mark. For everyone who belongs – without anyone having to say it out loud. Restrained enough for every day, clear enough for those who know.

lines.name: The country lines
lines.text: Albania. Afghanistan. Andorra. Argentina. For the home you can only feel – whether you come from there or it simply never let go of you.

values.label: Code of Conduct
values.title: The Family Code
values.intro: Not a rulebook. A door. Four things — if you nod at all four, you already belong. If one of them bothers you, this isn't your room. Both are fine.

items.title: We take each other seriously
items.text: Not the small-talk version. We ask what you're working on — and we wait for the answer. Anyone who only wants to be seen is in the wrong room.

items.title: We say it to your face
items.text: Honestly, even when it's uncomfortable. Talking about someone instead of to them is the one thing that doesn't work here.

items.title: We make ourselves useful
items.text: Someone here can open the door you're standing in front of. Ask. And when it's the other way round, open it.

items.title: We protect the room
items.text: No drama, no audience, no screenshots. What is said here stays here — that's why people actually talk.

long: The four sentences above are the result, not the beginning. Here is where they come from.

We take each other seriously — OneFam did not start as a clothing brand. It started with a feeling: being in the right room, with the right people, where you did not have to explain yourself. Anyone whose answer has a comma in it knows the other version well enough — the follow-up question, the short pause, the explaining. Here that falls away. What is left is the only question that counts: what are you working on. And we wait for the answer.

We say it to your face — In a room where nobody has to explain themselves, you can also say the uncomfortable thing. It does not land on who you are, only on what you are doing right now. That is what makes honesty possible here at all. And it is why talking about someone instead of to them is the one thing that does not fit: it takes away their chance to answer.

We make ourselves useful — This is not a statement of intent, it is already running. Which country gets made next is decided by the fam — we build what enough people put their name down for. In small ways it is the same: you see the mark on someone, and a conversation starts that otherwise would not have. We keep no ledger on this. Anyone who only takes will notice that less comes back.

We protect the room — This is the most uncomfortable of the four, and the one the other three depend on. “You do not have to explain yourself” only holds as long as nothing is carried outside. A room things get carried out of becomes, quite quickly, a room where nobody says anything. No drama, no audience, no screenshots — not out of secrecy, but so that anything real can be said here at all.
There is nothing more here. Not a place you go to — a feeling you carry.

philosophy.label: Philosophy
philosophy.quote: We surround ourselves with people who encourage us to become the best version of ourselves. We keep our distance from drama and negative influences like envy or hate. Instead we put our focus on good energy – so that the best in everyone becomes visible.

why_we_do_this.title: Why we do this
paragraphs: OneFam was born in a quiet time – when closeness happened through screens for a while.
It started softly: small, hand-picked gatherings for people who wanted to meet for real again. The right place, the right people – and conversations you left with more courage than you brought.
At some point the question came up: what if that feeling could travel with you – no matter how many places you call home? OneFam grew out of that.
Because people remember feelings – not percentages.
Being part of OneFam shouldn't feel like buying something – it should feel like belonging.

items.question: Does the shared trip already exist?
items.answer: No. The shared trip is our goal, not our current offer. We are building it carefully and properly – including the legal side – and we'll say so openly when the time comes. Until then we promise no one a trip.

items.question: Is this a prize draw or a lottery?
items.answer: No. There is currently neither a draw nor a prize, and nobody stakes anything. The waiting list is an ordinary newsletter: you enter your email, we get in touch, you can unsubscribe at any time.

items.question: What do I get from joining the waiting list?
items.answer: You'll be the first to know when we take the next step. No purchase, no conditions, no obligation.

items.question: Does buying something give me an advantage?
items.answer: No – at least not one you can win. When the time comes, buyers should help decide the destination.

items.question: What happens to the share of profit that is set aside?
items.answer: It stays put aside inside the company – for what we have planned with the community. Nobody pays into it, and nobody has a claim on it. As soon as it turns into a concrete offer, we'll set out openly how it works.

items.question: Who is behind OneFam?
items.answer: OneFam is run as a sole proprietorship based in Switzerland.

final_cta.title: Join the Fam
final_cta.text: If this feels like you, you're already part of it. Sign up – no purchase needed.
